question: In which of the following states/UTs were Khelo India Youth Games 2023 organised?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Khelo India Youth Games 2023** were organized in **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• The event aims to identify and nurture young sporting talent in the country.
 
• Khelo India Youth Games is a part of the **Khelo India programme**, an initiative by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** of India.
 
• The games include various sports disciplines, encouraging a culture of sports in India.
 
• Madhya Pradesh provided excellent facilities and infrastructure for the smooth conduct of the games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Punjab**__

 __
 
• **Punjab** is a state in northern India known for its rich cultural heritage and history.
 
• It is one of the leading agricultural states in India, often referred to as the **Granary of India**.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra**__
 __
 
• **Maharashtra** is a state in the western peninsular region of India occupying a substantial portion of the Deccan Plateau.
 
• It is the second-most populous state in India and houses the financial capital of India, **Mumbai**.
 
 
 
• **Delhi**__
 
 
• **Delhi**, officially known as the **National Capital Territory of Delhi (NCT)**, is a city and a union territory of India.
 
• It is the seat of all three branches of the Government of India, including the **Executive, Legislature, and Judiciary**.
